questions.question: Which container/VM classes and regions reliably support the required CPU, RAM, disk, and pause semantics, and at what account limits?

What revocation, cookie-domain, WebSocket, rate-limit, and audit guarantees apply to signed preview URLs at scale?
What PTY reconnect retention, backpressure, maximum session, and concurrent connection limits are guaranteed?
What are local disk, volume, archive, and snapshot durability/backup/RPO/RTO guarantees and deletion SLAs?
When will snapshot/fork APIs used here leave experimental status, and what compatibility guarantees apply?
Which regions support data residency, volume/snapshot locality, and deterministic placement?
